name: grammar-b-round
prompt: Four voices begin the same line one after another, chasing each other around the melody. The slowest voice trails by a little more each pass. The harmony stretches; the parts separate like boats on a widening river. By the end, three voices have finished and gone, and the slow voice is still singing the last phrase alone — not sadly, just inevitably. The drift was always the arrangement.
mood: gentle, inevitable, solitary at the end
structure: round entries staggered, voices drop out one by one, single sustained final note
extra: one voice noticeably slower, round gradually drifts apart, ends with only that voice
subject: the drifting round
